notes.title: Major Costume Pack Update!
notes.notes:
Hello Feign players! 🎉

We have exciting news for you: we've added brand-new costume packs to Feign! 🎁 You can now customize your characters with 4 different themes:


 Cardboard Theme Pack 📦: Gain a fun look with creative cardboard designs.
 Candy Theme Pack 🍭: Add color to the game with sweet designs.
 Lava Theme Pack 🌋: Draw attention with fiery costumes.
 Crystal Theme Pack 💎: Shine with mysterious and magical crystal costumes.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/85ed6770a44e1f2e89c318d735bd1da66a82d831.png

Along with this major update, we've also added the following improvements:


 In-Game Purchase System Added 🛒: You can now purchase costumes and other items directly from the market.
 Market Updated 🛍️: Our market is richer with new character costumes.
 Connection Infrastructure Updated 🔧: For a more stable gaming experience, we've upgraded our connection infrastructure to "socket.io" version 4.7.5.
 Player Disconnect Animation 🏃‍♂️: Players who disconnect now run away from the village instead of dying in front of the door, making it easier to understand the situation.
 Visual Improvements 🎨: Fixed minor visual glitches in the outlines of characters and houses.
 Translation Updates 🌐: We updated the game translations from Localizer for a smoother experience.


Thank you for your support, and have fun playing! 🎮

notes.title: Feign's New Animal Update and Hidden Achievements Are Here!
notes.notes:
Dear Feign Players,

We're excited to announce a new update! You'll now encounter various new animal species in our game. Newly added animals such as mole, fish, frog, and squirrel enrich the world of Feign even further and diversify your gaming experience. Additionally, previously existing animals like rabbits and birds have been revamped in this update.

With this update, hidden achievements have also been added to the game! To unlock these achievements, explore the animations and interactions of our new animal friends. While experiencing the innovations they bring to our world, also earn hidden achievements!

Which one is your favorite animal?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/a739e5cccda4618a55b155e5ab978ef54cf777da.png

notes.title: Mac Version is Out
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, Mac version of Feign is finally released. You can enjoy the game now if you have a mac. We also have some more updates released together with this event.

 Now we have a new winter theme added to the game. You can change it in the game via the sun & snow button on the upper left corner.
 Night and day music added that changes during the day and night cycle in the game
 Esc function added, you can now exit any menu by pressing Esc button on your keyboard.
 Flags in the game have been replaced with language names to avoid confusion.
 Also the ghost's candle bug has been fixed.
 The bug that caused the home outline to appear above the characters has also been fixed.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/e4765fbff162beeaba8521eea8f02635f627e9e8.png

notes.title: Skin System and In-Game Shop Update Launched
notes.notes:
Mustache, hat or glasses? Which one is your favourite?

Yes, the 5th major update to our itinerary, the Skin System and In-Game Shop upgrade has been completed and added to Feign today. You can open the game right now and dress your character in your favorite outfit.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/e4765fbff162beeaba8521eea8f02635f627e9e8.png

You buy the clothes with the Feign cookies 🍪, which make up our in-game currency system. These cookies are currently not available for sale. With the daily login reward, you can accumulate more cookies in your jar every day. Thinking that our characters might be very hungry for the first day, we shared 500 cookies with you for the first day in addition to the daily login reward 🍪🍪🍪.

notes.title: Release Notes v.0.3.3
notes.notes:
As you all know we enabled Cross-Play of Feign with Android Devices almost 2 weeks ago. So many new players have joined our PC players in the game, way above our expectations. You can see this situation in the game due to the intensity of the global lobbies.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/bda5dfb3e12fe48958b23e88fd1ff99ea089f35f.png

Although all this new player mass makes us very happy, we were aware that there were also some players who were experiencing problems such as slowdown in the game, late starts or not being able to start the games due to this density and new bugs that come with Feign mobile. 

We worked hard and solved all these problems! However, let us remind you that you can always report any problem you encounter with our bug report tool (the little red bug button in the upper right corner of the game 🙂). 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/dffdc4c5080820493071cbfbc4253902e7bd5534.png

Here is the list of items that are solved or added :


 A bug is solved that prevented some lobbies to start.
 A bug is solved that caused some players to drop from the game.
 Version control added for overall game experience.
 Automatic decks are updated
 Fixed a bug preventing Sorcerer to select an innocent investigator when using its role.
 Speak visualization button added for mobile players, so they can also show you in game that they are talking if you are in a discord channel together.
 In game notification system added for better communication with players. There are 3 types of notifications with a white or yellow or red label as shown below:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/1027379494b11e63d206920617c966724b7f67d3.png

notes.title: Release Notes v.0.2.3
notes.notes:
DOCTOR: - The doctor can no longer go to the same house 2 times in a row 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/02fec657cb87d069d3c1072f6977b2a432f7d693.png

POLICE: - The Police can't block the same person 2 times in a row 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/5b0a75e3794a0fef87e8971e842df9ca0026c11e.png

CLEANER: - Now you will not see it during the night if a cleaner cleans you and its effect stays forever. Also if that cleaned player is investigated or snitched only a yellow question mark will be seen.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/a34492be231ee4e6daab0749460445bd0dd445b4.png
So now cleaner can clean his imposter buddy to keep him out of harm's way or clean innocents to make it look like they are a cleaned impostor 🙂
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/d9aaa9cb4ed356c0ea910ca9256979ae176e88d9.png

SERIAL KILLER: The role of the person killed by a serial killer will always appear as an unknown yellow question mark.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/76cb0e8376017bdd73901fa6fb9dacd697e51480.png

BOMBER: The bomber will not be able to be blocked by the police when he tries to blow up his bombs.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/c059895431848055b61b15c8a0cdecb56fafd249.png

THIEF: When the thief steals the bomber role he steals also all of his bombs that he already placed in other houses. However, don't be afraid if there is also a bomb in your house. You will detonate all of your bombs except the one that is placed in your own house.
When the investigator role is stolen by the thief, it will also steal all of the information cards that the investigator already has.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/c268c41203585a987bc091f3beaac0a3fa0f15b9.png

INSANE:
Insane infrastructure has been upgraded. Now if an insane doctor visits a player, he sees that the insane doctor arrives at the house. So now the doctor will not be able to understand that he is not insane when he is seen. 
The insane role can also think now that he is a snitch.
When a lookout saw a lot of people visiting a house, he immediately thought he was insane. Now the number of players that the insane lookout sees is reduced to solve this issue.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/b5298c8f163b1335978696062e8395a2a53b7f26.png

PROVOKER: If the provoker stays alone with the impostor at the end of the game and if he provokes the traitor that night, the provoker won't be hanged anymore. So he can win by voting the impostor out.
If the provoker uses his role and if that person dies that night the provoker does not lose one of his provoking rights.

TRAPPER: The location of the trap set by the trapper will always be in front of the door, so there will be no visual error of being trapped behind the house and missing that information in case you were not paying attention.

GENERAL:
A special star is added next to the moderator's name so it is more visible now.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/a4cd0eea87a3d4963b0432cf78f39296d1ab9891.png
There is also a small icon added next to the player's his/her character in the game.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/54412b5f36662d61cfacafd7153f8b1fcc484aa0.png
Now dead players see both the insane role and the role that the insane players think he is.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/1931850367a0a72a023c79c6d65235ab400447cf.png
Dead players see also bombs that are already planted or if a person is blamed by the blamer.
Dead players can now also see how many rights the roles such as provoker, snitch, blamer, or survivor have left.
The information of the person joining the lobby is shared in the lobby chat. 
The character walking animation has been made smoother.
In terms of using the roles, the ranking is now randomized every turn, and the same roles, impostor or innocent, will have a different priority each turn. So for example, if 2 police try to block each other, every round the outcome can be different.

We also made some minor improvements and fixed a lot of bugs: 
Infinite sending error in bug reporting tool has been fixed 
Bug reporting tool not showing sent feedback has been fixed 
Fixed a bug where you could not cast votes in the next round if you tried to vote for a house during the animation.
Role usage infrastructure has been improved which solved minor bugs on role usage at night.
The connection infrastructure has been improved which solved the disconnection problem experienced by players with low processor power.
Fixed a bug that caused players leaving the game to be seen as a white role in the endgame panel.
Fixed the bug that caused insane or doctors to be seen sometimes as a red insane or red doctor role when they are blamed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/198ae06dd0d4d188361f7906c8631e344285db6b.png

notes.title: Release Notes v.0.2.2
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone, 
As you know we recently introduced our community to the new game mode where you can play with anyone around the world even if you don't know their language with the help of the auto-translate chat feature. However, we realized that waiting for 12 people in the lobby might take a little bit too long sometimes :) So we reduced these game lobbies to start at 8 people. However in normal custom lobbies and private lobbies you can still play together with up to 12 people.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/090d6a871522daf99740e4759d7d10faf94de724.png
So full list of bugs and fixes are listed below:

 The global lobby size has been reduced to 8 people.
 When players log in to global lobbies, the number of users required for the game to start automatically is reported in the chat.
 Fixed a bug where anyone could join private lobbies.
 Fixed a bug where sometimes players could not load the lobby, preventing the game from starting.
 Fixed the single-player lobby issue that remained open despite all players exiting.
 Fixed a bug that caused players to be able to enter full rooms.
 Fixed a bug that sometimes caused users with 32-bit CPUs to be unable to launch the game.
 Updated game link infrastructure.

notes.title: Hotfix v.0.2.1
notes.notes:
In this hotfix, we solved a bug that sometimes caused global lobbies not to start even if there are 12 people in the lobby. 
We also ordered the lobbies in the Join section of custom lobbies. Now Global Lobbies are shown on the top part of the custom lobbies list.
We solved a bug that hindered system messages to appear to current players and we fixed a minor bug that caused performance issues while opening and closing the new chat section during the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/e5cd1b128b4f68fd0b8e0ac0353dc22f8be640e5.png

notes.title: Release Notes v.0.2.0
notes.notes:
In this major release, we added 2 new important features: Quick Play and Auto translate chat feature. This Quick Play game mode will put you in an official lobby where you will play with random players around the world using only in-game written chat. The full list of items fixed or updated in this major release are listed below:


 New Game mode: Quick Play
 Auto translate chat feature
 New and easily understandable UI for in-game chat
 The role order of Insane is improved. Now it is executed in the order of the role that the insane thinks he or she is. Previously because of this bug if the insane thinks he is a cop and sees that the doctor visits him before he performs his role he knew that he is insane for sure. Now his insane character will perform his role in the right order.
 Now Lookout role sees also insane when both visit the same house in the same round
 Fixed a bug that caused the whole town to wait on the person that just left or dropped from the game during game start. So no more waiting on a vote of a dropped player 🙂 
 Switched to IL2CPP scripting backend
 Security improvement on Bug Report Tool
 Solved a bug that caused the game to freeze during zoom in and out
 Language translation improvements are done as suggested by our community in Localizor
 Chat spam limitation applied
 Memory optimization such as background-image character animations & images and fonts 
 Fixed the bug that sometimes caused all entities (such as characters, rabbits, etc) to move backward in the game.
 Settings panel improved
 Imposter in how to play mini-game has been changed to a serial killer for easy understanding
 The Winter theme is removed
 Menu background images are updated

notes.title: Release Notes v.0.1.8
notes.notes:
This week we mainly focused on game mechanics and worked on several backend requirements for the mobile version of Feign. Here you can see the list of items fixed/updated related to the game mechanics.

 We have seen that spamming of some actions were affecting game stability so we limited these actions up to 6 times per second as a maximum (Role usage at night, voting and pressing space to show you are talking )
 Snitch is nerfed. Now only the Snitch sees the actual role now of the snitched person. It is up to you to believe him or not.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/c14c0ff8a7c310efdc5ffb65775d6ca7a062f0f0.png
 Language font support is upgraded to solve unsupported fonts that were causing squares to appear for names of players and for messages in lobby chat.
 Voting system is updated. Now a person is kicked out of the town only if he/she receives majority of the votes. Also votes that were not being used until the timer runs out are counted as skip votes. Also in the event of a tie of votes no one is kicked out of the town. So a couple of voting examples are here to make it easier to understand: 
[**] Person A (3 Votes)  - Person B (4 Votes) - Skip (1 Vote) - #of alive and not voted people (4)  = No one is kicked out of the town
[**] Person A (3 Votes)  - Person B (4 Votes) - Skip (1 Vote) - #of alive and not voted people (2)  = Person B is kicked out of the town
[**] Person A (4 Votes)  - Person B (4 Votes) - Skip (1 Vote) - #of alive and not voted people (1)  = No one is kicked out of the town
[**] Person A (4 Votes)  - Person B (2 Votes) - Skip (1 Vote) - #of alive and not voted people (3)  = No one is kicked out of the town

notes.title: Release Notes v.0.1.6
notes.notes:
In this week's release, we mainly focused on game mechanics and requests from our community. Here you can see the list of items fixed/updated.

 Items that are requested/reported by our community:
 Erased a wrong heading in lobby listing page for lobby languages 
 Fixed a Steam Achievement of Provoker 
 Fixed the bug of the role doctor. (Whenever a doctor picks a house to perform his/her action and then changes his/her mind and selects any other house the first selected house looked like it is not clickable anymore.)
 Fixed a bug of serial killer role. If a serial killer targets a another player in the game, then the target of the serial killer was sometimes allowed to perform his actions before dying. This is not allowed anymore.
 Fixed a bug that sometimes prevented provokers to use their their non-killing role when they are imposter 
 Fixed a bug that let investigator to see sometimes an Insane role for the green card option when they were invetigating a red or blue person. Since investigator sees an insane player with its cover-up role (like police doctor etc) this was alerting the investigator that his target was indeed an imposter or neutral. 
 Updated the game mechanic of Blamer. Now when you blame a person he/she will be seen as the impostor version of their real role (e.g. a green police will be look like a red police)
 Fixed a bug that sometimes let a player who dies in that night to be trapped by trapper

notes.title: Patch Notes Version: 0.1.5
notes.notes:
Added in-game link for Feign Discord server for voice chat.
 Added Czech language support to the game.
 Fixed the bug that caused the resolution setting not to show every possible option on the settings page (Per our players' bug report)
 When there is at least one random role in the deck, Investigator can now see every possible option for that color as the second role option (not only one of the roles that are present in the game)
 Fixed the bug that allowed players to type in different colors and fonts in-game chat (Per our players' bug report)
 Fixed the bug that allowed  imposters last chat message to become visible right in the morning after they die (Per our players' bug report)
 Fixed the bug that caused the investigator to see 2 red roles for any player (Per our players' bug report)
 Fixed the bug that caused the thief to steal a wrong role when their first target is healed by the doctor and they killed some other target the following night.
 Fixed the bug that caused insane to see mostly correct roles when he/she thinks he/she is an investigator. (Per our players' bug report)
 Fixed a bug that sometimes caused the house images to become blurry.

notes.title: Patch Notes Version: 0.1.3

 The information about how long the current games are active has been added to the lobbies list.

 Updated the name of the character "Mad" to "Insane" in English version of the game.
